Message.Name: Login Message
Message.Description: The Login message is the initial message used to establish a trading session. It is also used to re-establish a session after a break.

Field.Name: protocolVersion
Field.Description: A two byte field to represent the version of the ATP protocol that the user conforms to with major version number in the most significant byte and minor version number in the least significant byte. i.e. The current version v2.9 is LSB =9 MSB = 2 represented by value 0x0209

Field.Name: senderId
Field.Description: Value as agreed with A2X to identify the Members ATP session

Field.Name: password
Field.Description: Password as agreed with A2X to verify the user

Field.Name: inactivityTimeout
Field.Description: Optional inactivity timeout in seconds. If there are no messages received for this period of time then A2X will close the session (triggering cancel on disconnect)

Field.Name: atpSeqNo
Field.Description: The next sequence number from A2X that the trading Member is expecting. After a drop or break in the session this can be used by A2X to identify a gap and trigger any missed messages to be re-sent (see Login Response).

Message.Name: Login Response Message
Message.Description: The Login Response message is sent by A2X to acknowledge a Login request, and either accept or reject it.

Field.Name: resultCode
Field.Description: Result of logon attempt 0 = Successful login 1 = Already logged in 2 = Sequence number error 3 = Unsupported protocol 4 = Failed authentication (incorrect password) 5 = Unknown Source Network

Field.Name: clientSeqNo
Field.Description: Next sequence number A2X expects to receive

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: A Heartbeat message is simply a message header with a heartbeat id as the message content. For a heartbeat, msgType is set to 0 and msgSeqNo is set to the sequence number that will be set on the next business message.

Message.Name: Logout Request Message
Message.Description: The Logout Request message is used by the trading Member to request the closure of a trading session.

Message.Name: Logout Message
Message.Description: The Logout message is usually sent as a response to the Logout Request however it may also be sent by A2X in case of a low sequence number or other protocol violation, or for other reasons. The TCP/IP connection is closed immediately after this message has been sent.

Field.Name: logoutReasonCode
Field.Description: Reason for logout 0 = User requested 1 = Admin (market operations) 2 = Disconnect 3 = End of Day 4 = Inactivity timeout 5 = Protocol error 6 = Sequence number error

Field.Name: reasonText
Field.Description: Text describing reason for logout

Message.Name: Order Add Message
Message.Description: The Add Order message is sent by the trading Member to enter an order for a particular security.

Field.Name: securityId
Field.Description: Numeric security identifier

Field.Name: orderType
Field.Description: 1 = Limit Order 2 = Auction on Demand (Limit Order) 3 = Auction on Demand (Trade at Middle/Limit or Pegged/Limit) 6 = Market at Close 8 = Post Only Cancel Replace (POCR) 9 = Post-Only (PO)

Field.Name: timeInForce
Field.Description: Time in force for this order 1 = Day order 2 = Fill or Kill (FOK) 3 = Immediate or Cancel (IOC) 9 = Good for Auction (GFA) Only Day orders are valid for the Market at Close (MaC). GFA orders are only valid for the Auction on Demand

Field.Name: side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy order 2 = Sell order

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: Limit price of the order (0 for MaC order)

Field.Name: orderCapacity
Field.Description: 1 = Agency 2 = Principal

Field.Name: account
Field.Description: Clearing account identifier possible values: 1 to 65,535 1=House Account >2=ID for agreed Client Account Code

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag assigned by trading Member

Message.Name: Order Add Extended Message
Message.Description: The Order Add Extended message is sent by the trading Member to enter an order for a particular security with additional attributes.

Field.Name: securityId
Field.Description: Numeric security identifier

Field.Name: orderType
Field.Description: 1 = Limit Order 2 = Auction on Demand Limit Order 3 = Auction on Demand Pegged Limit 6 = Market at Close 8 = Post Only Cancel Replace (POCR) 9 = Post-Only (PO)

Field.Name: timeInForce
Field.Description: Time in force for this order 1 = Day order 2 = Fill or Kill (FOK) 3 = Immediate or Cancel (IOC) 9 = Good for Auction (GFA) Only Day orders are valid for the Market at Close (MaC). GFA orders are only valid for the Auction on Demand

Field.Name: side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy order 2 = Sell order

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: Limit price of the order (0 for MaC order)

Field.Name: orderCapacity
Field.Description: 1 = Agency 2 = Principal

Field.Name: account
Field.Description: Clearing account identifier possible values: 1 to 65,535 1=House Account >2=ID for agreed Client Account Code

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag assigned by trading Member

Field.Name: displayQuantity
Field.Description: Display quantity for an iceberg order. Only valid for iceberg orders. For non-iceberg orders, value must be set to 0.

Field.Name: minQty
Field.Description: Minimum quantity (shares) of an order to be executed. Only valid when OrderType = 2 or 3

Message.Name: Order Add Response Message
Message.Description: A2X sends an Add Order Response message to acknowledge the receipt of an Order Add message.

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Order reference number

Field.Name: marketDataId
Field.Description: The id of this order as seen in the A2X market data. This value will be zero if the order is cancelled (IOC) or fully traded on entry

Field.Name: status
Field.Description: Status of order and reject or cancel code (if needed) First 3 most significant bits - order status; Lower 5 bits - reason code (if rejected or cancelled); Otherwise zero. See Section 4 for values.

Field.Name: tradedQuantity
Field.Description: Number of shares traded if any

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Time that the order was accepted or rejected by the A2X system

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag as assigned by trading Member on the Order Add message

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message
Message.Description: The Order Cancel message is sent when a user wishes to cancel an open order.

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Order reference number

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag assigned by trading Member

Message.Name: Order Cancel Response Message
Message.Description: A2X sends an Order Cancel Response to accept or reject an Order Cancel message. The message is also used if an order is cancelled by Market Operations or due to cancel on disconnect.

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Order reference number

Field.Name: requestRef
Field.Description: Sequence number (msgSeqNo) of the trading Members cancel request message. Note that this field will be zero in the case of a forced cancel by A2X Market Operations.

Field.Name: status
Field.Description: Status of order and reject or cancel code (if needed) First 3 most significant bits - order status; Lower 5 bits - reason code (if rejected or cancelled); See Section 4 for values.

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Time that the cancellation was accepted or rejected by the A2X system

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag as assigned by trading Member on the Order Cancel message

Message.Name: Order Modify Message
Message.Description: The Order Modify message is sent when a user wishes to modify an open order. Order quantity and/or limit price may be modified. Both values must be included, even if one of them is unchanged.

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Order reference number

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The new price of the order

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: The new order quantity

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag assigned by trading Member

Field.Name: orderCapacity
Field.Description: 0 = Unchanged 1 = Agency 2 = Principal

Message.Name: Order Modify Extended Message
Message.Description: The Order Modify Extended message is sent when a user wants to modify an open Order Add Extended. Order quantity and/or limit price and/or display quantity and/or minimum quantity may be modified. All values must be included, even if some are unchanged.

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Order reference number

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The new price of the order

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: The new order quantity

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag assigned by trading Member

Field.Name: orderCapacity
Field.Description: 1 = Agency 2 = Principal

Field.Name: displayQuantity
Field.Description: New display quantity of the iceberg order

Message.Name: Order Modify Response Message
Message.Description: A2X sends an Order Modify Response to accept or reject an Order Modify or an Order Modify Extended message.

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Order reference number

Field.Name: requestRef
Field.Description: Sequence number (msgSeqNo) of the trading Members modify request message.

Field.Name: status
Field.Description: Status of order and reject or cancel code (if needed) First 3 most significant bits - order status; Lower 5 bits - reason code; See Section 4 for values.

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Time that the modification was accepted or rejected by the A2X system

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag as assigned by trading Member on the Order Modify message

Message.Name: Iceberg Order Refresh Message
Message.Description: A2X sends an Iceberg Order Refresh message to notify the Member when an iceberg order is refreshed from the non-displayed reserve quantity.

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Order reference number

Field.Name: origA2xOrdId
Field.Description: The ID of the original order as seen in the A2X market data

Field.Name: newA2xOrdId
Field.Description: The ID of the Iceberg order refresh as seen in the A2X market data

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Refreshed display quantity of the iceberg order

Message.Name: Trade Capture Message
Message.Description: A2X uses a Trade Capture Report message for the purpose of allowing members to submit Large in Scale (LS), Negotiated Benchmark Cross (NBC) and Matched Principal (MP) trades to the exchange.

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares traded if any

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The price of the trade

Field.Name: securityId
Field.Description: Numeric security identifier

Field.Name: tradeCaptureType
Field.Description: 1 = Large in Scale (LS) 3 = Negotiated Benchmark Cross (NBC) 5 = Matched Principal (MP)

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag assigned by trading Member

Field.Name: buyAccount
Field.Description: Clearing account identifier possible values: 1 to 65,535 1=House Account >2=ID for agreed Client Account Code

Field.Name: buyOrderCapacity
Field.Description: 1 = Agency 2 = Principal

Field.Name: sellAccount
Field.Description: Clearing account identifier possible values: 1 to 65,535 1=House Account >2=ID for agreed Client Account Code

Field.Name: sellOrderCapacity
Field.Description: 1 = Agency 2 = Principal

Message.Name: Trade Capture Response Message
Message.Description: A2X sends a Trade Capture Response Message to accept or reject a Trade Capture Message.

Field.Name: status
Field.Description: Status of order and reject or cancel code (if needed) First 3 most significant bits - order status; Lower 5 bits - reason code; See Section 4 for values.

Field.Name: tradeRef
Field.Description: Trade reference number.

Field.Name: requestRef
Field.Description: Sequence number (msgSeqNo) of the trading Member's Trade Capture Message.

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag as assigned by trading Member on the Trade Capture Message.

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: The Trade message is published when an order executes. The Trade message is also used to communicate indicative trade reports at lock time for Market at Close orders. Note that the price and tradeRef values will be zero for indicative trade reports published when MaC orders are matched at lock time.

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Order reference number

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares traded if any

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The price of the trade

Field.Name: side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy order 2 = Sell order

Field.Name: tradeRef
Field.Description: Trade reference number

Field.Name: ccpCode
Field.Description: Clearing CCP code 1 = Self clearing 2 = EMCFNL2A

Field.Name: liqIndicator
Field.Description: 1 = Added liquidity 2 = Removed liquidity 3 = Removed liquidity (hidden quantity)

Field.Name: securityId
Field.Description: Numeric security identifier

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Time that the trade occurred on the A2X system

Field.Name: userTag
Field.Description: Free form tag as assigned by trading Member on the Order Add message or the most recent Order Modify message

Message.Name: Trade Bust Message
Message.Description: If a trade is invalidated, a Trade Bust message is sent to notify the trading Member.

Field.Name: orderRef
Field.Description: Order reference number

Field.Name: quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares on invalidated trade

Field.Name: price
Field.Description: The price of the invalidated trade

Field.Name: side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy order 2 = Sell order

Field.Name: tradeRef
Field.Description: Trade reference number for the invalidated trade

Field.Name: timestamp
Field.Description: Time that the trade was busted by A2X Market Operations

Field.Name: reasonCode
Field.Description: Reason code if rejected or cancelled; otherwise zero

Field.Name: orderStatus
Field.Description: Order status

Value.Name: Post-Only Cancel
Value.Description: Post-only cancel (cancel to prevent aggressive trade)

Value.Name: Post-Only Cancel Resting
Value.Description: Post-only cancel resting (cancel to prevent aggressive trade)

Value.Name: Order Cancelled
Value.Description: Order cancelled as a result of modification which updates the remaining quantity to zero

Value.Name: Auction on Demand Trade at Middle Limit or Pegged Limit
Value.Description: Auction on Demand (Trade at Middle/Limit or Pegged/Limit)

Value.Name: Price Does Not Conform To Tick
